title: Generated SECTIONMANAGER/SECTIONSETTINGS adapter graph closure
scope: Bounded AC1021+ DXF adapter output for SECTIONMANAGER membership, SECTIONOBJECT group-360 settings references, and nested SECTIONSETTINGS source/destination/geometry fields.

section_settings.finding: SECTIONSETTINGS is an object with a common owner and AcDbSectionSettings body.

section_manager.finding: The manager exposes a section count and repeated group-330 section-entity pointers.

section_object.finding: SECTION exposes a group-360 settings-object handle.

nested_type.finding: Section type settings carry source object pointers and an optional destination block.

nested_geometry.finding: Section geometry settings define the modeled layer, linetype, color, hatch, lineweight, and transparency fields.

implementation.capture: dx_iface retains bounded typed SECTION callbacks and bounded source DXF SECTIONMANAGER/SECTIONSETTINGS carriers with private import-time snapshots. Export rejects capture-budget failure, changed carriers, unmodeled raw fields, opaque DWG tails, unsupported common data, duplicate identities, and non-AC1021+ targets.
implementation.graph: The manager count must equal its bounded member list and each member must resolve uniquely to a SECTIONOBJECT entity. Every nonzero SECTIONOBJECT group-360 handle must resolve to a retained SECTIONSETTINGS record; settings must be referenced, source handles must resolve to unique entities, and destination handles must resolve to unique BLOCK_RECORDs. Common owners are limited to the NOD root or a reciprocal SECTIONOBJECT owner. Legacy flat settings are admitted only when their modeled mirrors and destination target are consistent.
implementation.output: SECTIONMANAGER/SECTIONSETTINGS group-5 identities are reserved after the shared source-handle remap. The existing low-level writer resolves manager members, nested source handles, and destination blocks through the final output resolver, with source-handle remap fallback.
implementation.bounded_profile: Generated AC1027 profile with one SECTIONMANAGER, one SECTIONOBJECT, one nested SECTIONSETTINGS type, one entity source, and one destination block-independent geometry settings record.

validation.inputs: Generated ASCII/Binary DXF authored by the test helper and in-memory typed records; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
cases: Exact remapped VIEW group-334, SECTIONOBJECT group-5/group-360, manager group-330, and nested settings source identities are checked in output.
Fresh ASCII/Binary import checks manager membership, settings association, source-object identity, and nested geometry fields.
Missing settings, wrong-kind target, duplicate settings identity, duplicate SECTIONOBJECT identity, pre-AC1021 target, and changed raw carrier each preserve the existing destination.
The same adapter succeeds after the refusal cases are corrected.

qualification_limits: Generated transport and graph closure only; no physical producer source-span or owner-profile evidence is established.
No native section-generation, live-section, or 3D kernel semantics are qualified.
Unsupported raw fields, common data, tails, color-book/RGB variants, and unclosed dependencies remain fail-closed.
